description: Learn how to hide cursor in ChatGPT on Mac. Since macOS lacks a native toggle, we show you the best system-wide tools to achieve a clean interface.
targetKeyword: how to hide cursor on mac
intro: To hide your cursor while using ChatGPT on a Mac, you must use a third-party utility because macOS lacks a native system-wide setting for this. You can use tools like Cursorcerer to toggle the visibility of your mouse pointer with a simple keyboard shortcut.
tldr: There is no built-in setting in the ChatGPT Mac app or the web version to hide the mouse cursor.
The most reliable way to hide the cursor system-wide is by installing the third-party utility Cursorcerer.
Once installed, you can toggle the cursor on and off using the Control + Option + K keyboard shortcut.
For screen recordings, professional software like OBS Studio allows you to disable the cursor in the capture properties.

blocks.text: Why you cannot hide the cursor natively

Many users want to hide their cursor when taking screenshots or recording videos of their workflow in the ChatGPT desktop app. A visible cursor can be a distraction when you want to showcase the interface or clean text generation. Unfortunately, Apple does not provide a setting in macOS to toggle the visibility of the mouse pointer. The cursor is a primary interaction tool for the operating system, and the system design assumes you always need to see where you are clicking.

The ChatGPT app for Mac, which was rebuilt on July 9, 2026, does not include any internal controls to hide the pointer either. Even if you hide the sidebar or collapse the interface, the mouse pointer remains visible. This is a system-level behavior that requires a system-level solution. You should avoid looking for this setting inside the ChatGPT preferences menu, as it simply does not exist.
Using Cursorcerer to hide your cursor

The most effective way to manage your cursor visibility is by using a small utility called Cursorcerer. This tool is a preference pane that installs into your System Settings. It gives you the ability to hide the cursor on demand using a keyboard shortcut. It is lightweight and does not interfere with your daily work.

items: Download the latest version of Cursorcerer from the developer website.
Double-click the installer file to add it to your System Settings.
Open System Settings and look for the Cursorcerer icon in the sidebar.
Configure your preferred hotkey, typically Control + Option + K.
Test the shortcut while the ChatGPT app is active.

blocks.text: If you find that the cursor reappears immediately after you move the mouse, go into the Cursorcerer settings and ensure that the option to show the cursor on movement is disabled.
blocks.title: Preventing accidental reappearances

blocks.text: If your primary goal is to record a clean video of your ChatGPT interaction, you might not need to hide the cursor system-wide. Standard macOS recording tools like QuickTime or the screenshot toolbar do not allow you to hide the cursor. Instead, use professional recording software like OBS Studio. In OBS, you can add a display or window capture source and uncheck the Show Cursor box in the source properties.

This method is safer because it keeps the cursor visible for your own navigation while ensuring it is absent from the final video file. This is the standard approach for content creators who need to show software interfaces without the clutter of a moving mouse pointer.

When you are working on a clean screen recording, you want the ChatGPT app to be fast and responsive. Since the July 2026 update, the app integrates Chat, Work, and Codex. If you notice the app becoming slow or unresponsive, it is often due to the size of the conversation history. Try starting a new chat for your recording session to ensure the app is performing at its best.

If the app feels sluggish, you can try clearing the app cache. Restarting the application often resolves temporary glitches that occur during long sessions. Remember that the app requires macOS 14 or newer, whether you are on Apple silicon or an Intel processor. Always ensure your system is updated to maintain compatibility with the latest features.

A common mistake is attempting to use Terminal commands to hide the cursor. Many older forum posts suggest using specific defaults write commands. These are often deprecated and can cause instability in modern versions of macOS like Sequoia. Stick to reputable third-party utilities that are designed for your current version of the operating system.

Another mistake is confusing the mouse cursor with the text insertion point. Some accessibility settings for the blinking text cursor are often mistaken for mouse pointer settings. These are two completely different things. Changing your text cursor thickness or blink rate will have no impact on your mouse pointer visibility.

faq.question: Can I hide the cursor inside the ChatGPT app settings?
faq.answer: No, the ChatGPT desktop app does not have a setting to hide the mouse cursor.

faq.question: Is there a native macOS setting to hide the mouse pointer?
faq.answer: No, macOS does not provide a system-wide toggle to hide the mouse cursor.

faq.question: What is the best way to hide the cursor for screen recordings?
faq.answer: Use professional recording software like OBS Studio, which allows you to uncheck the Show Cursor option in the capture source properties.

faq.question: Is Cursorcerer safe to use?
faq.answer: Cursorcerer is a well-known utility for macOS. Always download it from a reputable source to ensure your system security.
